## Purpose

Renders the Library page — a single-file browsable/searchable catalog of the agents, skills, and hooks
available across all pipeline types, each with a detail modal. Mounted by `DashboardLayout` for
`mainView === "library"`.

## Shape

- [LibraryPage.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/library/LibraryPage.tsx) — one component holding three independent filter/search states (agents by
  pipeline-type category, skills by category, hooks by event type) switched via a `Tabs` primitive,
  plus two in-file detail modals:
  - `SkillDetailModal` — parses a skill's markdown content into sections for display
  - `HookDetailModal` — explains the hook's event type and usage

  Agent detail is delegated to the existing `AgentCapabilitiesModal` from `components/workflow`. Data
  sources are static: `LIBRARY_AGENTS`/`CUSTOM_AGENTS` from `components/workflow/AgentLibraryData`,
  `SKILLS` from `@/data/skills`, `HOOKS` from `@/data/hooks`.

- **Modal state mirrors the URL (spec 015-frontend-routing)**: `closeDetailModal` closes whichever
  detail modal is open via `router.push(routes.library(...))` rather than a local `setSelectedX(null)`,
  so a page refresh right after closing doesn't reopen the modal — the URL is the source of truth,
  matching what browser Back already did.

## Why this shape

**A single-file page with in-file modals is proportionate here** — the module has no server state
(everything is a static catalog import) and no cross-page reuse, so splitting the two detail modals
into their own files would add navigation overhead without reducing complexity.
